blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NITI Aayog possesses no powers to allocate financial resources or funds.
The body functions strictly in an advisory capacity, making its recommendations non-binding.
The practical implementation of any proposal relies entirely on acceptance by the government.

blocks.content: • Advisory role only – recommendations are not binding.

items: NITI Aayog cannot allocate funds to states or ministries (unlike the former Planning Commission).
Recommendations given by NITI Aayog are purely advisory and carry no binding authority.

blocks.content: • Depends on government acceptance for implementation.
